result.summary: Deprecates the `replaceable` argument across ten raw transaction, wallet, and PSBT creation/modification RPCs (`createrawtransaction`, `createpsbt`, `fundrawtransaction`, `walletcreatefundedpsbt`, `send`, `sendtoaddress`, `sendmany`, `sendall`, `bumpfee`, and `psbtbumpfee`). Supplying the argument now raises an `RPC_METHOD_DEPRECATED` error unless the node is started with `-deprecatedrpc=bip125`. It also relocates the BIP 125 sequence number explanation comment to `util/rbf.h` and updates functional tests.
result.problem: Since full-RBF became the default mempool policy in Bitcoin Core v28, transactions are replaceable across the network regardless of BIP 125 opt-in signaling. Maintaining the `replaceable` argument across transaction creation and fee-bumping RPCs is redundant and preserves unnecessary opt-in signaling controls in the public API.
evidence: Addresses #32661 ("wallet, node: Redundant opt-in RBF wallet config and RPC parameters").

Author in PR description: "fullrbf is the default policy and prevalent in the network (since bitcoin core v28 was released in late 2024) that makes every transaction replaceable by default, making this user option unnecessary."

enables: Complete removal of the `replaceable` RPC argument in a future release (#32661).

result.scope_notes: Mechanically introduces deprecation checks across ten distinct RPC endpoints, guarded by the `-deprecatedrpc=bip125` flag.
result.changed_since_previous: Moved BIP 125 sequence documentation from `src/wallet/spend.cpp` to `src/util/rbf.h` and expanded functional test coverage in `test/functional/wallet_deprecated_rbf.py`.
result.card: Deprecates the replaceable argument across ten transaction and PSBT creation and modification RPCs, throwing an RPC_METHOD_DEPRECATED error unless -deprecatedrpc=bip125 is enabled at startup. Because full-RBF has been standard mempool policy since Bitcoin Core v28, transactions are replaceable by default and explicit BIP 125 opt-in sequence signaling is redundant. This resolves issue 32661 and prepares the wallet RPC interface for complete removal of the parameter in a future major release.

risk.why: Existing external scripts or wallet clients that explicitly pass the replaceable argument will fail at runtime unless configured with -deprecatedrpc=bip125.
